definitions.explanation: a special envelope with decorative paper strips (noshi) and colored cords (mizuhiki) used for giving money as gifts for celebrations

examples.japanese: のし{袋|ぶくろ}に{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}いた。
examples.english: I wrote my name on the gift envelope.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}にはのし{袋|ぶくろ}でご{祝儀|しゅうぎ}を{渡|わた}す。
examples.english: At weddings, you give congratulatory money in a decorative envelope.

examples.japanese: コンビニでのし{袋|ぶくろ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a gift envelope at the convenience store.

notes:
COMPOUND:
{熨斗|のし} (decorative paper strip) + {袋|ぶくろ} (bag, envelope)

ELEMENTS:
- {熨斗|のし} - decorative folded paper
- {水引|みずひき} - decorative cord
- {表書|おもてが}き - writing on front (occasion name)
- {名前|なまえ} - giver's name

TYPES:
- {紅白|こうはく} (red and white) - for celebrations
- {黒白|くろしろ} (black and white) - for funerals
- Tied with bowknot (repeatable events) or square knot (one-time events)

OCCASIONS:
- {結婚|けっこん} - wedding
- {出産|しゅっさん} - birth
- {入学|にゅうがく}/{卒業|そつぎょう} - school events
- お{見舞|みま}い - get-well visits

RELATED:
- ご{祝儀|しゅうぎ} - congratulatory money
- {香典|こうでん} - condolence money
- お{年玉|としだま}{袋|ぶくろ} - New Year's money envelope
